score_notes.scripture: All parts of our service are grounded in the Bible, which we are committed to upholding.
score_notes.soteriology: spread the Good News of Jesus in our community, state and world
score_notes.preaching: you’ll hear our faith expressed in the songs we sing, prayers we offer up and our pastor’s preaching.
score_notes.mission: It is the mission of this church to Love God , Love Others and to Advance the Kingdom of God .
score_notes.cultural: make God known in our community and around the world
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Men’s ministry meets for Fellowship Breakfast the third Saturday of each month at 8:00am and second Tuesday of each month at 6:00pm for Taco Tuesday.
score_notes.denominational: We are affiliated with the Southern Baptist Convention and we agree with the Baptist Faith and Message 2000 .

slater-baptist-church-slater-sc.assessment: A revitalized mill-village church in Slater pastored by Scott Catoe and David Watson — orthodox, evangelical, mostly Reformed, with all sermons posted. A model replant.

score_notes.denominational: SBC (SC Baptist Convention listed) with confessional Reformed identity.

slater-baptist-church-slater-sc.pastor_credentials: Catoe: North Greenville University + Southern Baptist seminary training (site bio); replanting specialist
